messages:
sarah (sales): FYI ACME POC is hitting 429s during mixed chat+embedding workload, started ~09:10 UTC. Their tests used the test key we provided.
eli (eng-sre): Can you paste the full response headers from one of the 429s?
sarah (sales): pasted from their agent:
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Content-Type: application/json
Retry-After: 2
X-RateLimit-Limit: 12000_tokens/min
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-RateLimit-Group: tenant:acme-corp
X-Request-Id: req_0a1b2c3d
```
acme-poc-bot: log excerpt: "2026-03-12T09:09:58Z WARN token_budget_exhausted tenant=acme-corp tokens=12987 window=60s"
eli (eng-sre): Interesting - X-RateLimit-Limit shows token granularity. Looks like their burst consumption crossed the tenant token_budget. Are they streaming embeddings as separate calls or batch?
sarah (sales): they run a hybrid: streaming chat (server-sent events) + background embedding jobs every user session (batch of 16).
maria (eng-runtime): That pattern easily spikes token burn: streaming chat holds open prefix + embeddings are full-context -> token accounting counts both. Default per-tenant token_budget is 100k/min for trial keys.
sasha (sales-eng): They asked for higher throughput for the demo. Can we temporarily raise quota while we finish POC? :eyes:
eli (eng-sre): We can bump their tenant quota but want to confirm it's not a client bug (no retries, exponential backoff). Do they honor Retry-After?
sarah (sales): client logs show naive retry every 200ms with no jitter for embeddings.
maria (eng-runtime): That will amplify. Recommend three-step: 1) increase tenant token_budget to 400k/min temporarily, 2) patch client to backoff with jitter + exponential, 3) instruct to batch embeddings smaller (8) or use embedding dedupe.
els (typo)
eli (eng-sre): also can add a short-term per-route soft-cap for embeddings to smooth spikes: route quota 200k/min with a streaming priority queue to throttle non-interactive jobs.
sasha (sales-eng): What's the impact on Dedicated customers? Any risk?
maria (eng-runtime): No infra risk — quotas are logical; for hosted multi-tenant we just update the tenant record. If they need guaranteed throughput long-term, recommend Dedicated or reserved capacity.
ops-bot: incident:rate_limit_alert created for tenant=acme-corp at 2026-03-12T09:11:12Z (priority=low)
eli (eng-sre): Can infra/ops temporarily raise quota? I can add a short-lived override.
maria (eng-runtime): +1. I'll prepare an override: set token_budget=400000/min for tenant acme-corp, expires in 72h.
sarah (sales): please add note to SOW and email customer: we'll do a temporary quota bump while they implement client fixes.
sasha (sales-eng): I'll notify customer and ask for logs showing Retry-After handling.
eli (eng-sre): Quick mitigation for them now: - reduce embeddings batch from 16->8, - add jittered retries (base 500ms, max 5s), - stream chat with lower prefix retention (truncate history to last 2 turns).
sarah (sales): Customer asked about cost — will temporary bump increase billing?
maria (eng-runtime): Usage will bill as normal. For POC we'll mark this as comped (finance ok per policy) if they upgrade to paid within 30 days.
sasha (sales-eng): noted, I'll coordinate finance. :thumbsup:
acme-poc-bot: client log after applying retry-jitter patch: "2026-03-12T09:28:05Z INFO retries with backoff: success"
eli (eng-sre): After quota bump + client fix we should see X-RateLimit-Remaining no longer drop to 0. Watch for token spillover next 24h.
sarah (sales): thx team — I'd like an ops confirmation once override applied.
maria (eng-runtime): override applied at 2026-03-12T09:14:30Z by maria: token_budget=400000/min expires=2026-03-15T09:14:30Z
ops-bot: audit: tenant_override created tenant=acme-corp by maria (runtime)
eli (eng-sre): I'll monitor and will open a follow-up if we see >3 alerts in 12h.
sarah (sales): perfect, closing loop with customer now.
sasha (sales-eng): can we add a short doc snippet for POC best practices: "avoid embedding+streaming spikes"? I'll draft.
maria (eng-runtime): I'll add config snippet for client-side backoff to our devex templates.
sarah (sales): thanks all :wave:"
